name: claude-mem-grok-bot
description: Persistent memory for Grok Bot. No host hooks: transcript watcher plus MCP. Local worker with host-login observer, or remote cmem.ai. Install without Cursor.

author.name: Ahmet Sami Gül (fork of claude-mem by Alex Newman)

CLAUDE_MEM_MCP_URL.title: Remote MCP URL
CLAUDE_MEM_MCP_URL.description: Leave empty for a local worker (stdio). Set to https://cmem.ai/api/mcp for remote.

CLAUDE_MEM_MCP_TOKEN.title: Remote MCP token
CLAUDE_MEM_MCP_TOKEN.description: Bearer token for remote MCP. Unused for local worker.
